name: 32730 · Fern Park, FL
findings: ZIP 32730 (Fern Park) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32730 (Fern Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32730 (Fern Park) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
